description: This file defines an interface IImbalanceToleranceRule within the Orleans.Placement.Repartitioning namespace, representing a rule for controlling imbalance tolerance between silo activations during load balancing.

classes.name: IImbalanceToleranceRule
classes.description: An interface that specifies a rule to determine if a certain imbalance level between silo activations is acceptable.

methods.name: IsSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the given imbalance value satisfies the rule.
